claims.assertion: Yazhi says three arks are at the Pentagon, Russia’s Vostok base, and her ship.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says arks safeguard biology and can serve as weapons.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Ukraine may hold ancient bases that could be looted under the metaphorical “ark” label.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She is unsure whether a literal ark exists.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says the ark story may distract from broader war causes and foster hopes of rescue.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says an ark may exist but is not the war’s sole cause.
